images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / game UI mockup.
Asset type: ONE full-screen 16:9 landscape gameplay direction image for the Japanese 3D physical-comedy game 全力退勤, version 0.7. This is a proposed PRE-IMPLEMENTATION generated mockup, not an actual screenshot. Produce a polished 1920x1080-style landscape frame, NOT a poster, NOT a storyboard sheet, no inset panels.

Reference roles: Image 1 is the current real game screenshot: preserve the brown-haired panicked salaryman in white shirt and loosened tie, chunky teal office chair, red extinguisher, playable oblique overhead camera, teal office desks, cream tile floor, left-side sunset windows, visible route toward a distant open elevator. Image 2 defines the EXACT recognizable three props: rounded teal two-tier caster wagon loaded with cream papers and teal/navy binders; absurd tall layered paper-and-binder tower on a small teal base; brown cardboard paper box with red 書類 stamp. Image 3 defines the rounded brown-haired teal-vest coworker with cream cat mug. Image 4 is only the comic typography / HUD / local impact-star / paper-frame style reference, not an illustration of the correct jet direction. All images are design references, not pixel-preserving edit targets.

Primary request: show ONE instantly readable causal gag: the player's chair has just rammed a loaded wagon, the moving wagon strikes and bends the adjacent tall paper tower, the falling tower crushes a cardboard paper box, flying paperwork reaches an office supervisor who reflexively STAMPS APPROVAL, while a second coworker fiercely protects a cat mug. The player is already trying to escape toward the elevator. This single chain should feel staged, physical and funny, with recognizable damaged objects, not objects vanishing into generic particles.

Scene and composition: stay close to Image 1's achievable rounded toy 3D game world with slight voxel accents only in tiny fragments. Camera is fixed oblique elevated third-person, floor, upcoming route and all chair wheels readable. Player around lower center-left, about 27% of image height, sprinting diagonally toward upper center. Show his panicked open-mouth face in a three-quarter pose, both hands naturally managing the red extinguisher, loose tie trailing; keep his face unobscured. A white connected extinguisher plume with a fine cyan edge originates at the short black hose nozzle and goes BACKWARD toward bottom-left, opposite travel; do not point the nozzle or exhaust at the wagon or face. Keep an open teal floor route from chair toward a clearly recognizable distant green EXIT/open elevator in the upper-center background.

Destruction chain arranged along the RIGHT EDGE of this route, at three clearly separated contact points, all readable in the same world perspective: (1) teal wagon just ahead/right of the chair, skewed on its casters, a wheel lifting slightly, one shelf bent and papers spilling, a short visible curved wheel track from chair contact to wagon; (2) wagon's front physically touching the tower base farther upper-right, tower bent over like a banana, large layered slabs of paper and several chunky binders peeling and tumbling outward; (3) tower's fallen binders physically pressing a small cardboard box farther along the same arc, box pancaked and split at folds, cream sheets erupting from it. Preserve the wagon frame and tower base on the floor; scatter a modest readable trail of paper, two binders and one small caster beside the route. The three impact points use progressively smaller asymmetric gold/navy/coral comic stars, brief curved motion strokes, and a controlled fan of large individually readable cream papers. No large blast, no fire, no rubble wall, no physically injured people. The contact geometry and motion strokes must explain wagon -> tower -> box WITHOUT big instructional arrows or diagram labels.

Coworker comedy: exactly TWO nearby reacting employees, each distinct and outside the path. On the right-side desk near the last box, a same-universe rounded male supervisor with small glasses, white shirt and teal vest stares straight at a flying cream sheet that has landed on his desk; his hand visibly brings a SHORT RED INK STAMP DOWN onto that sheet, leaving one clear red 承認 mark. He looks startled but mechanically keeps approving. Tiny ivory speech ticket directly above him reading 承認！. On the left-side nearby desk, the brown-haired coworker from Image 3 swivels toward the actual falling tower, eyes wide, recoils slightly, BOTH HANDS clutching the intact cream CAT MUG safely against their chest; a few sheets narrowly pass the desk and a small speech ticket reads マグ死守！. A third distant small coworker by a CRT is relaxed and still typing, no speech balloon and no flinch. Reacting coworkers should be large enough to read faces and gestures, but smaller than the main character. Gaze directions, flying papers and the stamp pose connect their reactions to THIS chain. No extra characters.

Lighting and art: sunset amber from the left windows, matte rounded toy-plastic shapes, navy outlines, warm cream shadows with grounded contact shadows. Refined teal/cream office with red extinguisher and gold impacts as the strongest accents. Let background desks and floor be calmer than the action. Crisp game-render look, approachable low-poly forms and separate animated-looking pieces, not photorealism, not cinematic depth of field, not painterly concept art. Main face, contact points, coworkers and next floor route must stay cleanly separated and legible.

HUD and text: maintain the established v0.5 paper UI as in Images 1 and 4. Top-left clipped navy/red timecard: 退勤TIME and 00:12.48. Top-center narrow teal exit tab: EXIT ↑ 64m. Top-right serrated cream expense receipt: 被害総額 and ¥480,000; directly below, one large gold 3 with a small cream 連鎖×3 ticket. ONE compact gold/navy comic notification in the upper free band below the exit tab, exact text 書類、全提出！, and a small separate +¥30,000 receipt. It must not cover faces, tower or floor route. Bottom-left cream extinguisher meter with small red extinguisher pictogram, exact text 消火器 残圧68%, segmented gauge about two-thirds full, small 離すと回復. Bottom-right concise navy keycaps ← →, SPACE, R, ESC with tiny labels 旋回, 噴射, 再挑戦, ポーズ. Keep all HUD horizontal, within generous safe margins, top band about 17% and bottom band about 14% of the frame. Slight halftone paper printing, crisp bold Japanese glyphs, chunky cream/navy outlines, red monetary numbers. No title logo. A very small neutral corner tag may read 実装前イメージ v0.7. Use the listed Japanese strings verbatim, no other words or random labels.

Constraints: single coherent gameplay frame; preserve established actor/prop identities and game-camera family; joy comes from physical chain reactions and the two distinct coworker gestures; keep the central route and exit readable; no new weapons, powers, giant particles, extra HUD panels, score-time mixing, screenshare/desktop chrome, borders outside the game, photorealism, blur, fake screenshot claims or injuries.
